:::{#exr-list-as-vector}
#### Store a data point as one object

A house has a floor area of $120$ square meters,
$3$ bedrooms,
and an age of $15$ years.

1. Write these three numbers as a single vertical list $\vx$,
   in the order given,
   and call its entries $x_1$, $x_2$ and $x_3$.
   What is $x_2$?
2. Does the list $(3, 120, 15)$ describe the same house?

:::
